about_the_game:
MEET KIRSTEN!

The "hot" firefighter ready to set your heart ablaze! Her form-fitting uniform clings to her curves, glistening with heat, while beads of sweat trace a tempting path down her body. With delicate yet strong hands gripping a firm hose, Kirsten dreams of sweeping you off your feet, saving you from danger with fiery embraces and passionate kisses…

This irresistible beauty is more than just a hero, she’s your devoted companion and playful lover! Kirsten adores roleplay, indulges in deep blowjobs, and has a passion for experimenting with an array of sex toys — many of which she crafts herself in her private lab. Keep Kirsten on your home screen, and let her tantalizing smile and breathtaking figure brighten your every moment!

WHAT YOU'RE GETTING

In addition to the mascot, you'll receive 5000 credits and 150 Super Serums.

Most importantly, you'll have our sincere gratitude! Thank you for supporting us by purchasing this DLC!
